newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks squeak out higher close.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks squeak out higher close.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks recovered only a bit of lost ground to close up on Wednesday, boosted by a recovery in some heavy property counters but pulled down by selling in conglomerates and banks, brokers said.
"This was a rebound of sorts, but the market is likely to be easier before we see another rally," said Mansfield Mak in institutional sales at ING Barings.

The Hang Seng Index advanced just 8.40 points to 13,462.61, after zigzagged in a relatively narrow range for most of the day. Turnover was a healthy HK$6.84 billion, though well off Tuesday's HK$7.57 billion.
"Today was the kind of day one should sit back, ignore the market, and read research because whatever you do, you know it will be wrong," said Janet Gillies, sales executive at OCBC Securities.
Chartists were also cautious in the assessment of the market's current trend.
"It looks like we are settling into big trading range with support at 13,180 and strong resistance at 13,860," said Alex Wong, analyst at Dharmala Securities.
Wong said short-term indicators were mixed and the futures continued to trade at a discount to the cash market.
Property stocks, chiefly those that had been sold off recently, put in a positive performance. All other blue chips sectors closed lower. Mid-cap issues outperformed most of the market.
Sun Hung Kai Properties 0016.HK) closed HK$1.00 higher at HK$89.25. Chartists said the share was rebounding off its long-term trend line and should see good upside.
Henderson Land 0012.HK and Cheung Kong both gained HK$1.00 to HK$71.00 and HK$74.75, respectively.
Heavyweight HSBC climbed HK$0.50 to HK$187.50, while Swire Pacific fell HK$0.50 to HK$68.25.
Mid-cap HAECO advanced HK$0.40 to HK$25.00 and Lai Sun International added HK$0.30 to HK$11.60.
Red chips were generally stronger on good volume.
CITIC Pacific ended HK$0.10 lower at HK$38.40 on moderate volume of HK$206.29 million.
Shanghai Industrial jumped HK$1.30 to HK$28.90 on good trade of HK$85.31 million.
China Resources climbed HK$0.35 to HK$16.40 and Guangzhou Investment rose HK$0.225 to HK$3.525
H share newcomer China Eastern Airlines gained HK$0.05 to HK$1.43 on moderated volume of HK$91.29 million.
